name: haunt
description: Stress-test any agent workflow with chaos engineering: test one reusable block alone, chain blocks, see which block broke the chain, and get a graded what-if or a hardening spec. Runs on its own: one bundled MCP server, no checkout needed.
author: kakoritz
highlights: Test a block alone, then chain blocks and see which block broke the chain (haunt_blocks, haunt_chain)
Model-based what-if of any haunt.yaml with a grade and the parts to add (haunt_lab)
Reviewer agent turns a run into a postmortem and a hardening spec; nothing is applied for you
Runs offline: one bundled server, network off, local files only
useCases: Find which step of your workflow double-charges, drops or repeats work, before the world does.
Compose a workflow from reusable blocks and see which block breaks it.
Get a hardening spec for the failing stage and re-run to compare grades.
configuration: Nothing to set up. The server runs from the app folder with node. For haunt_sweep and haunt_ramp (real bot runs), set HAUNT_ROOT to a Kiroween Chaos checkout. Nothing is installed or enabled automatically.
